description: This file defines an abstract base class 'LookupBase' for lookup reference operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including validation methods and match checking utilities for spreadsheet lookup functions.

classes.name: LookupBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods for lookup operations, such as validation of lookup arrays and index numbers, and matching logic in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: validateLookupArray
methods.description: Validates that the provided lookup array is indeed an array, throws an exception if not.

methods.name: validateIndexLookup
methods.description: Validates that the index number used for lookup is numeric, greater than or equal to 1, and within bounds of the lookup array.

methods.name: checkMatch
methods.description: Checks and updates the row number based on matching criteria, considering data types and exactness of match.
